title: The Last Mile
text: Pilgrims walk the last mile to the shrine on their knees, the road worn into two grooves by centuries of it, the stones dark with old blood. A monk at the milestone says it is the only way to be heard. He is very sure of this. His own knees are scarred white.

options.label: Each Scion decides whether to walk the last mile on their knees, as the pilgrims do.

outcomes.text: Bloody knees, and a quiet mind, and the shrine bells ring as they arrive.

options.label: Each Scion decides whether to walk it on their feet, and leave the blood to the faithful.

outcomes.text: The monks frown, and turn their backs.
